hypothesis: A two-checkout differential run can expose dependencies on untracked files, environment leakage, or warm caches.
hypothesis_outcome_bound: Supported for hidden state that changes the normalised observable outcome. A read that leaves the outcome unchanged is not detected; that bound is demonstrated by a fixture rather than asserted, and recorded as LIM-PO03-WA-008-01.

method.design: One command is executed in a candidate warm checkout as it actually exists and in an independently materialised checkout of the same immutable commit under a sanitised environment. Each side is repeated to separate intrinsic nondeterminism from hidden-state dependence. When the normalised outcomes diverge, the clean side is replayed with exactly one class of the warm checkout's hidden state re-applied, then with each class withheld, then with all classes applied, which yields sufficiency, necessity and closure evidence rather than a guess.

classes.UNTRACKED_FILE_DEPENDENCY: working-tree files absent from the commit tree and not matching a cache glob
classes.ENVIRONMENT_LEAKAGE: ambient environment variables absent from or differing from the sanitised baseline, excluding deliberately redirected and process-volatile keys
classes.WARM_CACHE: working-tree paths matching declared cache globs, plus the contents of the external cache root exposed as XDG_CACHE_HOME

method.class_disjointness: Cache globs take precedence over generic untracked classification, so the three classes partition the observed hidden state; asserted by test_cache_and_untracked_classes_are_disjoint.
method.out_of_scope_reporting: Modified tracked content and checkout ref state are inventoried and named as out-of-scope candidates but never attributed, because the frozen hypothesis names three classes.
method.reproduction_design: Three sanitized repository-native scenarios at immutable commit affc82b35e6205010fda90f9914a97e467294a44: the seeded PO-03 contract suite with naturally generated bytecode caches, the seeded contract validator invoked on a sanitized candidate document present only as an untracked file, and the repository taxonomy gate.
method.exact_falsifier: Either a warm-only green mutant of any class is reported as clean, or a clean control with hidden state present is reported as dependent, or a divergence caused by state outside the three classes is attributed to one of them.

observed.repository_native_attribution: S2 attributed to UNTRACKED_FILE_DEPENDENCY with warm exit 0 and clean exit 2
observed.verdict_recurrence: 12 of 12 across two independent matrix runs
observed.digest_recurrence: 11 of 12; the nondeterministic fixture cannot have a stable outcome digest
